name: Todo list or dashboard
summary: A CRUD app for items/tasks with optional status, priority, filters and persistence, often shown as a list, board or summary dashboard.
entities: item/task: id, title, optional detail, status, priority, due date, tags
mechanics: Create, edit, complete and delete items; validate empty titles.
Filter by status/priority/text and keep counts in sync.
Persist items so a reload keeps the data.
Optional: drag between columns, reorder, bulk actions, undo.
ux: Empty state with a clear first action.
Keyboard add (Enter) and accessible labels; focus returns after actions.
Confirm destructive bulk actions; show inline errors.
pitfalls: Counts drift from the visible filtered list.
Data lost on reload because writes are debounced incorrectly.
Editing state shared between rows; wrong item updated.
Delete without confirmation for bulk actions.
Broken empty state or inaccessible controls.
defaults: Single-user app with localStorage persistence and no auth.
List view with add, edit, complete, delete and a text filter.
Status and priority are optional; keep the first version small.

ask.en: Where should the items be stored?

suffix.en: Persist items in localStorage; no backend or auth.
suffix.tr: Kayıtları localStorage'da tut; backend ve giriş olmasın.

suffix.en: Persist items through a backend API and database.
suffix.tr: Kayıtları backend API ve veritabanı üzerinden tut.

suffix.en: Do not add accounts or authentication.
Add simple user accounts and per-user data.
suffix.tr: Basit kullanıcı hesapları ve kullanıcıya özel veri ekle.

verification: Add, edit, complete and delete update the list and counts immediately.
Reload keeps the data when persistence is enabled.
Text/status filters show only matching items and counts stay consistent.
Empty title is rejected with a visible message; no duplicate ids.
Empty state appears and the first action works.
Keyboard add (Enter) works and focus returns after edit/delete.
No console errors and no stale state after rapid actions.
